tips_en: Read S-Agent 2.0 first: its central insight—that reliable spatial reasoning depends on a closed evidence loop between model perception, tool measurements, and persistent scene memory—offers the clearest conceptual contribution and strong practical gains. Together, the papers share a theme of explicitly managing evidence and state in AI systems: S-Agent 2.0 organizes geometric scene memory, AKV manages KV-cache state, and FCP removes teacher-forcing shortcuts to improve learned world dynamics.
tips_zh: 建议先读 S-Agent 2.0：其核心洞见是，可靠的空间推理依赖模型感知、工具测量与持久化场景记忆之间形成闭环，概念清晰且实践增益显著。三篇论文共同关注如何显式组织智能体或模型的证据与状态：S-Agent 2.0 管理几何场景记忆，AKV 管理 KV-cache 状态，FCP 则通过消除 teacher-forcing 捷径改善世界动态学习。
